Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
"Tower of London : Master: unique location. When an action requiring
Necromancy is successful, tap this location to gain 1 pool."

It works when recruiting Shambling Hordes, although the card isn't an action
card, because to recruit then you need Necromancy, right ?

"Sanguine Instruction : Requires a ready vampire. +1 stealth action. Choose
a discipline this vampire has at superior. Put this card on a ready vampire
of the same clan as this acting vampire. The vampire with this card has the
normal level of the chosen discipline. If the vampire already had the
discipline, he or she now has the superior level of that discipline. The
vampire's capacity increases by 1; the vampire is one generation older.
Cannot be played on a vampire with the superior version of the discipline."

So, in order to teach Necromancy, you need to have it ; so, in a way,
playing this card to teach Necro "requires" necro ; so, would you win 1 pool
with the Tower ???

--

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>"Tower of London : Master: unique location. When an action requiring
>Necromancy is successful, tap this location to gain 1 pool."
>
>It works when recruiting Shambling Hordes, although the card isn't an action
>card, because to recruit then you need Necromancy, right ?

You can use the Tower when recruiting Shambling Hordes. Shambling Hordes is an
action (recruit ally) that requires Necromancy. Notice that it says "action,"
*not* "action card" (like Beast and Matteus).

>"Sanguine Instruction : Requires a ready vampire. +1 stealth action. Choose
>a discipline this vampire has at superior. Put this card on a ready vampire
>of the same clan as this acting vampire. The vampire with this card has the
>normal level of the chosen discipline. If the vampire already had the
>discipline, he or she now has the superior level of that discipline. The
>vampire's capacity increases by 1; the vampire is one generation older.
>Cannot be played on a vampire with the superior version of the discipline."
>
>So, in order to teach Necromancy, you need to have it ; so, in a way,
>playing this card to teach Necro "requires" necro ; so, would you win 1 pool
>with the Tower ???

I would say no, you cannot use the Tower of London.

You do not need Necromancy to play the card. There is one particular effect
that you can invoke if you have NEC, but the card does not require you to have
NEC (you could very well teach DOM or OBT instead).

Halcyan 2
